svg.title: Audit of a two-venue BTC JPY cross-spread dataset
svg.desc: A compact audit summarizes 10,285 sampled rows, raw negative cross-spread rates and data-coverage gaps, and concludes that the data is not execution evidence.

g.text: The raw screen found dislocations—not a strategy
BTC/JPY best-bid/ask reconstruction from two public venue feeds · 7–15 May 2026, JST
Best bid/ask snapshots were carried forward between updates.
Buy bitFlyer ask / sell Coincheck bid
of rows were negative before costs
Buy Coincheck ask / sell bitFlyer bid
of rows were negative before costs
WHY THIS IS NOT EXECUTION EVIDENCE
The generated sample has 10 gaps longer than two minutes; the longest is 21 minutes.
Individual quote ages, executable sizes and order-arrival sequencing were not retained—so a negative reading cannot be treated as a fillable trade.
Negative here means only that the displayed cross-spread was below zero before fees and execution costs.
